rows.note: Use this for the measurable size of an object, such as its height, width, or depth.

example.english: Before I buy a box, I need to know the dimension of this shelf.
example.traditional: 我買個箱之前，要知呢個架嘅尺寸。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 go3 soeng1 zi1 cin4 jiu3 zi1 ni1 go3 gaa3 ge3 cek3 cyun3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for one aspect or side of a matter.

example.english: Safety is one dimension where we still need to be more careful.
example.traditional: 安全方面，我哋仲要小心啲。
example.jyutping: on1 cyun4 fong1 min6 ngo5 dei6 zung6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1
